subject: Risk-explanation kickoff: explaining why risk went up, not just that it did
body:
Team,

Kicking off the risk-explanation productization. Our open-source release trains a model that generates a sequence of risk predictions over clinical observation records and - the part hospital partners actually want - explains increases as weights over the inputs. A risk score that jumps overnight with no explanation gets ignored by clinicians; one that says "these three observations drove it" gets used.

The codebase already speaks the right dialect: tf.SequenceExample in TFRecord format with FHIR-style observation features (Observation.code, value.quantity, harmonized valueset names) and labels like in_hospital_death. Partners are FHIR shops, so ingestion is genuinely close.

Milestones for Mar 23 - Jun 22: training reproduction on the reference data by Apr 17, explanation-quality review with a clinical advisor by May 22, partner-pilot readiness (including privacy sign-off - health data, so we file immediately) by Jun 19.

Jelena owns staffing and platform dependencies.

Dmitri
